statements.status_notes: The fix for CVE-2026-118764 is minimatch 11.0.1. No 10.x or 3.x release contains the fix, so the 10.2.x copies in Uptime Kuma 2.x and the 3.1.5 copy in Uptime Kuma 1.x are not remediable without a semver-major upgrade. Both lines pin minimatch as transitive dependencies of their npm trees. Adopting minimatch 11.x is a major-version change with breaking-change risk, so it is deferred. Reachability of the amplification path in the shipped runtime is under assessment; this statement will be revisited when the major upgrade is evaluated.

The advisory fixed release is minimatch 11.0.1, a major version upgrade from the 10.2.x line resolved in smartbear-mcp production node_modules. Adopting that upgrade requires a dedicated migration with full build and test validation; that work is not included in this patch release.
